subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the B58 across all 23 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The B58 is one of the broadest-application engines we work on — the same base engine across 13 model lines, spanning saloons, SUVs, a roadster and now a hybrid SUV flagship.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components where required — with 48V system components and hybrid cooling lines additionally accounted for on MHEV/PHEV applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the B58 across any of its 13 applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed B58 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
